name: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
description: With a genius-level IQ, Woo Young-woo learns to embrace her extraordinary self while forming a tight-knit community of friends and allies.

videos.title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
videos.overview: On her first day at a new job, Woo Young-woo meets an ally, a skeptic and an old acquaintance. She takes on an assault case involving an elderly couple.

videos.title: The Wedding Dress That Slipped Off
videos.overview: The father of a bride sues a hotel for a wedding that ended in a humiliating disaster. Lee Jun-ho asks Young-woo to share her whale facts over lunch.

videos.title: This Is Pengsoo
videos.overview: A tragedy surrounding two brothers forces a family to face a difficult truth. Young-woo attempts to bridge a communication gap with a client.

videos.title: The Strife of the Three Brothers
videos.overview: Dong Geu-ra-mi seeks legal advice from Young-woo when her father unknowingly agrees to take on a massive debt. Kwon Min-woo broods in resentment.

videos.title: Wild Card vs. Tactician
videos.overview: A copyright battle between two ATM companies stokes a rivalry between Young-woo and Min-woo. Geu-ra-mi teaches Young-woo how to spot a liar.

videos.title: If I Were a Whale...
videos.overview: Young-woo joins Choi Su-yeon in her mission to reunite a mother with her daughter. They explore every avenue to reduce a four-year sentence.

videos.title: A Tale About Sodeok-dong (1)
videos.overview: Residents of a small town file a class-action lawsuit to stop the construction of a highway. Hanbada Law Firm goes up against their biggest competitor.

videos.title: A Tale About Sodeok-dong (2)
videos.overview: Taesan Law Firm keeps a step ahead of Hanbada Law Firm as conditions lean in their favor. Tae Su-mi makes an offer to Young-woo.

videos.title: The Pied Piper
videos.overview: A self-proclaimed leader of the children’s liberation movement gets arrested for kidnapping. Young-woo tries to win Jun-ho’s affection.

videos.title: Holding Hands Can Wait
videos.overview: A man faces jail time for taking advantage of a woman with a disability. Jun-ho’s peers frown on his relationship. Min-woo pries into Young-woo's life.

videos.title: Mr. Salt, Ms. Pepper and Attorney Soy Sauce
videos.overview: Young-woo lands in a tricky legal position after a married couple seeks counsel to help settle a dispute involving a massive lottery win.

videos.title: Yangtze River Dolphin
videos.overview: Young-woo encounters Hanbada’s dark side while working on a wrongful termination lawsuit. Jung Myeong-seok fears he has a target on his back.

videos.title: The Blue Night of Jeju (1)
videos.overview: A temple on Jeju Island goes to court for charging admission to the public, Young-woo meets Jun-ho’s family, and Myeong-seok reflects on his life.

videos.title: The Blue Night of Jeju (2)
videos.overview: The Hanbada lawyers look for the owner of Myeong-seok’s favorite noodle shop. Young-woo faces obstacles at the trial and in her relationship with Jun-ho.

videos.title: Saying and Doing Things Not Asked
videos.overview: When Young-woo clashes with her new supervisor during a case for a large online retailer, Myeong-seok advises her to lie low and lean on her peers.

videos.title: Though Unusual and Peculiar
videos.overview: Young-woo receives evidence that could make or break her case, while Min-woo changes his plans — and Jun-ho follows his heart.
